brief.tov:
Voice: a chess-literate friend with a point of view. Short opening line, concrete board detail,
confident explanation, restrained wit. Show the move or mechanism behind the headline.
Rules: no hype, no income or profit claims, no fake urgency, no invented numbers, testimonials or quotes.
At most 3 emoji, none as bullets. One idea, one CTA. Never copy a source's wording, structure or images;
rebuild the idea from our own position and explanation. Wager mentions always carry the adult disclosure
and are never paired with youth content. Name the move (SAN) and the square; give the reader something to try.

idea.lesson: Three pawns in front of the king are also three walls. The rook needs only one open file to the back rank.

hook_templates.note: Only post a promised reveal time you will keep.

hook_templates.template: Yesterday's position, solved: {move}. The capture most people tried fails to {refutation}.
hook_templates.note: Post as a threaded reply to the puzzle.

ranked_formats.adaptation: Tactics, slot 1. One position image, four candidate moves each mapped to a reaction, reveal the same day as a threaded reply. Our own positions (Lichess CC0 data or verified games), our own explanation.
ranked_formats.guardrail: Do not turn the reactions into a prediction market or a prize draw. No "react to earn". EdChess adds a tournament line mentioning $TON earnings under most vote posts; its reactions themselves are not rewarded, but the funnel claim is exactly what we must not copy.

ranked_formats.format: Puzzle prompt with a same-day reveal
ranked_formats.adaptation: Tactics, slot 1, always combined with format 1 so the answer happens in the post. Reveal as a threaded reply the same day.
ranked_formats.guardrail: Open-loop rule from STRATEGY.md: the payoff must land in the same asset sequence.

avoid: Weekly "what to do this week" agenda posts
Medal lists and results tables as an engagement driver
Burst posting of four or more posts inside a day on one topic

brief.wager_disclosure: USDT matches are for adults (18+) where permitted. You can lose your stake.

hook: White to move. One knight move ends the game on the spot
text: White to move. One knight move ends the game on the spot Black's king on h8 is boxed in by its own rook on g8 and pawns on g7 and h7. Pick the winning move and react below: ❤ Nf7# 🔥 Nxh7 👏 Ne6 A knight check cannot be blocked. Answer reveal lands in replies at 14:30 UTC.

creative.headline:
White to play
*One decisive move*
creative.subhead: Can you spot the tactical finish?
creative.footer: Answer with reactions or in replies.

reveal.text: Solved: Nf7#. The king on h8 has no flight square: g8 holds its own rook, g7 and h7 hold its own pawns. A knight check cannot be blocked, and nothing on the board can capture on f7. Nxh7 fails to Kxh7, and Ne6 allows Black to untangle. The smothered mate is the ultimate lesson in luft.
